tool.name: PrecheckFeatureClasses
tool.displayname: Check Feature Classes Before a Batch Run

param.name: workspace
param.dialogReference: The geodatabase or folder that holds the polygon feature classes a batch run will use, for example one feature class per county. Every polygon feature class at the top level is checked; point and line feature classes are ignored.

param.name: wildcard
param.dialogReference: Limits the feature classes by name. Use * for any characters, for example *_County . The default * checks every polygon feature class.

param.name: coverage_layer
param.dialogReference: The area your input data covers. A feature class that does not touch it is skipped with the reason "outside the coverage layer". For a raster the coverage is its extent; for features it is the union of their shapes.

param.name: erase_layer
param.dialogReference: Polygons to remove before the area test, for example exclusion zones. The tool erases them from each feature class (Pairwise Erase, in memory) and measures the area that is left.

param.name: min_area_km2
param.dialogReference: A feature class runs only if more than this area is left after the erase. The default 0 skips only feature classes with nothing left. Available when an Erase Layer is set.

param.name: out_table
param.dialogReference: A table with one row per feature class: FC_Name, Iteration, Row_Count, Area_km2, Left_km2, Action (RUN or SKIP) and Reason.

param.name: run_list
param.dialogReference: The feature classes that passed every check, ready for a batch tool or a model.

tool.summary: Checks every polygon feature class in a workspace before a batch run and marks each one RUN or SKIP: it must have features, touch the coverage layer and keep some area after the erase layer is removed. It is the script twin of the ModelBuilder logical tools If Row Count Is and If Spatial Relationship Is.
tool.usage:
• Skipped feature classes are listed as warnings with the reason; the tool itself still succeeds.

  • Feature classes are checked in name order. ModelBuilder's Iterate Feature Classes may use a different order.

  • Areas are in square kilometers and need a projected coordinate system in meters.

dataIdInfo.idPurp: Decide RUN or SKIP for every polygon feature class before a batch run.
